info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Denial Management API enables users to efficiently manage the deletion of denied insurance claims in a batch process. This endpoint allows for the removal of multiple claims that have been marked as denied, streamlining the claims management workflow for insurers. Typical consumers include claims adjusters and administrative staff who require a systematic approach to maintain accurate records and reduce clutter in their claims database. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operations and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to deny a claim request submitted to the system. Upon successful execution, the claim will be marked as denied, preventing any further processing or approval.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to deny a claim. It must contain the necessary details for processing the denial, ensuring that all required fields are accurately filled out to facilitate the operation.

DeleteInsuranceClaimsClaimsDenyRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a claim denial operation.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the process related to the claim.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

DeleteInsuranceClaimsClaimsDenyResponse_.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on claims denial.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

automated.description: Indicates if the action was performed by an automated process.

AuditDetails.description: Audit information related to the request.
